3457-4613-6859.easyPrerequisites:
Servant of Tymaret doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Seeker of Skybreak is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
3457-4613-6859.description:
Activate Servant of Tymaret using Seeker of Skybreak's ability by tapping it, untapping Servant of Tymaret
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat.

3760-5147--86.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
The card used to grant indestructible is affecting Broodhatch Nantuko.
3760-5147--86.description:
dealing 1 damage to any target
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature, dealing 1 damage to Broodhatch Nantuko
Broodhatch Nantuko triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat.

3055-6495-6553.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
3055-6495-6553.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2511-2738-4556-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Blight Mound, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1409-3099-4289-4460.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more counters on it

145-687-5413-6099.notablePrerequisites:
There are three removable counters among creatures you control excluding the first three +1/+1 counters on Mossborn Hydra.
You control at least three enchantments.
145-687-5413-6099.description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Serra's Sanctum.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Serra's Sanctum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Serra's Sanctum enters, Mossborn Hydra triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
145-687-5413-6099.notes: The prerequisite can be waived if Mossborn Hydra has six or more counters on it.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3000-3899-4478.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

560-2558-6737-6797.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
When the Soldier enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

678-1718-7182.description:
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Ashling and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Ashling trigger, creating a token copy of Catalyst Elemental with haste.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Catalyst Elemental from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Catalyst Elemental token by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Catalyst Elemental by paying {2}{R}.
Repeat.
678-1718-7182.notes: If you have enough mana to cast Catalyst Elemental, step 5 can be skipped.

856-2558-5147-6748.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
856-2558-5147-6748.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, which is a Food due to Ragost, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Sword of the Meek trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Repeat.

2363-4616-5220.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Hangarback Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Hangarback Walker from your library, and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

3101-3292-3892-5295.easyPrerequisites: You have an amount of {R} available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
3101-3292-3892-5295.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
3101-3292-3892-5295.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

4311-5078-6259.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

765-1479-6754.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1479-6754.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Eusocial Engineering, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2433-4574-6687-6689.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
2433-4574-6687-6689.description:
Cast Rosie Cotton by paying {2}{W}.
When Rosie Cotton enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a Food token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Rosie Cotton's second ability and Golbez trigger.
Resolve the Rosie Cotton trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Holding priority, activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting an artifact creature card from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Golbez ability, putting the artifact creature card from the top of your library into your graveyard.
Unshakable Tail triggers, creating a Clue token.
Repeat from step 3.

5231-6014-6659.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another modified creature.
When the creature dies, Guardian of the Forgotten triggers, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters the battlefield, Gylwain triggers, creating a Role token attached to the manifested creature.
Repeat.

1580-2292-4647-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

880-3470-3585.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Greensleeves trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

282-1537-2034-3094.notablePrerequisites: Delina does not have summoning sickness.
282-1537-2034-3094.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Delina's trigger, with the copy targeting Zealous Conscripts.
Resolve the copy of Delina's trigger, creating at least one token copy of Zealous Conscripts that is tapped and attacking.
When the Zealous Conscripts token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, untapping Lithoform Engine and up to one other applicable permanent for each remaining trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Zealous Conscripts token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

730-1479-5478-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
730-1479-5478-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Emeria Angel trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2292-5011-5326.notablePrerequisites:
Cavalier of Night in exile with a takeover counter on it.
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
2292-5011-5326.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When The Master enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, doing nothing.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1624-3646-4827-5049.manaNeeded: {8}{G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1624-3646-4827-5049.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Strovald by paying {4}{G}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Storvald enters the battlefield, it triggers, giving Evra base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Evra by paying {4}, causing your life total to become one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

1409-1633-3503-4705-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional Spirit.
You have no cards in hand.
Spectral Arcanist is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
1409-1633-3503-4705-5195.description:
Activate Spectral Arcanist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Spectral Arcanist enters the battlefield, triggering itself twice and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability once.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Spectral Arcanist.
Resolve a Spectral Arcanist trigger, casting Hanabi Blast from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Storm-Kiln Aritst triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, dealing 2 damage to any target, returning Hanabi Blast to your hand, and then causing  you to discard Hanabi Blast.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1479-2638-3756.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2638-3756.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Tireless Tracker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3140-4944.description:
Activate Soltari Guerrillas's ability targeting a creature.
Crackdown Construct gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
